user.title: Li Auto
user.description:
Enter your Li Auto account phone number and password.

**What happens next?**

1. The integration signs in to Li Auto's servers with your credentials
2. If this is the **first time** signing in from this device, Li Auto will require **SMS verification** (with a slider captcha you must complete in your browser)
3. The integration opens a helper page where you complete the verification
4. Once verified, this device is marked **trusted** and no further verification is needed

> ⚠️ Signing in invalidates the Li Auto App session (sign in again in the App if needed).

browser.title: Li Auto · First-time login verification
browser.description:
A new device login requires SMS verification, and the captcha uses a slider that cannot be automated inside Home Assistant.

**Open the link below in your browser and complete the login** (drag the slider + enter the SMS code):

## 👉 [Open the login helper page](/lixiang-login?token={token})

> The link above is **relative** — your browser fills in the current Home Assistant address automatically
> (works whether you are on the LAN or remote).

If it does not open, copy **any** of these full addresses into your browser:

{url_alt}

---

On that page: **① enter phone + password → ② tap "get code" and drag the slider → ③ enter the SMS code → ④ wait for the green banner**, then come back here and press Submit.

> 💡 **Outside your home network (e.g. in the car)?** Use the **external** address from the list above.
> Internal addresses (`192.168.x.x` / `10.x.x.x`) only work on your home Wi-Fi.

Device ID: `{device}` — once verified, this device is marked as trusted and will not need verification again.

vin.title: Vehicle VIN
vin.description:
The integration tried to read the vehicles on your account automatically but did not succeed.

{hint}

### When do I need to enter VIN manually?

- Your account has more than one vehicle
- You use a family (non-owner) account
- The automatic lookup failed temporarily

### Where do I find the VIN?

Li Auto App → **Me → Vehicle → Vehicle info**. The VIN is a **17-character** alphanumeric code.

> Submitting empty = skip (no realtime status or remote control).
